video.title: AI欧腐《王冠禁宠/The Crown's Forbidden Pet》
video.desc:
Drugged and set up by his fiancée, fallen noble Ivan climbs into tthe bed of the ruthless Crown Prince Keller, only to discover he's his own half-brother. Bound by forbidden deesire and a thirst for revenge, the two join forces to bring the royal family down.
没落贵族Ivan遭未婚妻下药陷害，阴差阳错爬上了冷酷王储Keller的床。可他很快发现，这位残忍强势的王储，竟然是自己同父异母的兄长。
禁忌的欲望与复仇的渴望，将两人牢牢绑在一起。为了向曾经毁掉他们的人讨回一切，Ivan与Keller决定联手，掀翻整个王室。
